annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/1256 of 26 April 2024 amending and correcting Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 as regards harmonised standards for front loader agricultural machinery, all terrain vehicle quads, as well as electric motor-operated hand-held tools
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/1256 of 26 April 2024 amending and correcting Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 as regards harmonised standards for front loader agricultural machinery, all terrain vehicle quads, as well as electric motor-operated hand-held tools
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing decision amending Decision 2023/1586 on harmonised machinery standards under Directive 2006/42/EC. Following German and French formal objections, it restricts presumption of conformity for standards on agricultural front loaders, quads and hand-held electric tools. It concerns conventional machinery safety, not AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: EN 12525 (front loaders) loses presumption of conformity for points 1.1.2 and 1.7.4.2(l).
EN 15997 (ATV quads) restricted for safety integration, stability and uncontrolled movement.
EN 62841-1 and 62841-2-11 restricted regarding unintentional starting after voltage loss.
Article 3 of Decision 2023/1586 corrected on withdrawal of references with restrictions.
Enters into force on the day of publication in the Official Journal.
